about_short_description.short_description: Automate Your Fundraising. Finta helps early-stage companies raise capital faster.

product.name: Finta AI
product.description: An AI-powered fundraising assistant that automates investor research, contact enrichment, personalized email drafting, and pipeline management to help companies raise capital.

product.name: Investor CRM
product.description: A customer relationship management system tailored for fundraising that tracks investor interactions, automates contact updates, and manages deal pipelines in real time.

product.name: Deal Rooms and Data Rooms
product.description: Secure online spaces for sharing pitch decks, due diligence documents, and closing materials with investors, with controlled access and engagement tracking.

product.name: Investor Database and Matching
product.description: A database of active investors that uses AI to recommend the best investor matches for a company's fundraising round, including LinkedIn profiles and warm introduction pathways.

product.name: Warm Introduction Network (Finta Networks)
product.description: A tool that identifies and unlocks warm introductions to investors, donors, and partners through a company's existing network of team members, shareholders, and advisors.

product.name: Finta Fundraising Academy
product.description: An educational program offering tactical masterclasses, community support, and resources to help founders accelerate their fundraising knowledge and skills.
